title: Grade 4 SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — General Assessment #18

pages.quiz:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these is a benefit of proper waste management? (1 mark)
   A. A clean and healthy environment
   B. More flies
   C. More disease
   D. More floods

2. Which unit is used for the volume of milk? (1 mark)
   A. Metre
   B. Gram
   C. Kilogram
   D. Litre

3. What should you do if you find a needle or broken glass in waste? (1 mark)
   A. Put it in your pocket
   B. Pick it up with bare hands
   C. Tell a teacher and do not touch it
   D. Play with it

4. What does reuse mean? (1 mark)
   A. Bury it
   B. Use something again
   C. Burn it
   D. Throw it away

5. What does the stem do? (1 mark)
   A. Makes seeds
   B. Makes food using sunlight
   C. Holds up the plant and carries water and food
   D. Only takes in water

6. Which of these is true about the small intestine? (1 mark)
   A. It swallows food
   B. Digested food passes through its wall into the blood
   C. It chews food
   D. It stores faeces

7. Which of these is NOT an animal? (1 mark)
   A. A tilapia
   B. A wooden toy horse
   C. A housefly
   D. A cow

8. How does mulching help save water? (1 mark)
   A. It reduces evaporation from the soil
   B. It makes soil hot
   C. It makes soil dry
   D. It makes water flow away

9. Which of these is an example of a place where water may be recycled? (1 mark)
   A. A road
   B. A dry shamba
   C. A tap
   D. A water treatment plant

10. A caterpillar changes into a butterfly. Which sign of life does this best show? (1 mark)
   A. Feeding only
   B. Growing
   C. Dying
   D. Breathing out

11. Which of these is a stem that stores food and is eaten or used for sugar? (1 mark)
   A. Bean pod
   B. Tomato
   C. Sugarcane
   D. Sukuma wiki leaf

12. Which waste is both decomposable and from an animal? (1 mark)
   A. Dung
   B. Plastic
   C. Tin
   D. Glass

13. Which of these is a solid? (1 mark)
   A. Steam
   B. A stone
   C. Air
   D. Milk

14. Why do farmers remove weeds from a crop field? (1 mark)
   A. So crops get enough water, light and space
   B. To make weeds grow
   C. To stop rain falling
   D. To harm the crops

15. Which of these is a reason we need gases? (1 mark)
   A. We can write with them
   B. We can sit on them
   C. We breathe air
   D. We can build houses with them

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Describe an activity to observe the growth of a bean seed. Include what you need, what you do and what you record. (5 marks)

17. Give four ways in which heat is used in farming. (4 marks)

18. Describe four effects of forces using examples from daily life. (4 marks)

19. What is the difference between a vertebrate and an invertebrate? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — A clean and healthy environment
   Proper waste management protects health and the environment.

2. D — Litre
   Liquid volume is measured in millilitres and litres.

3. C — Tell a teacher and do not touch it
   Sharp objects should be handled by adults using tools.

4. B — Use something again
   To reuse is to use again.

5. C — Holds up the plant and carries water and food
   The stem supports the plant and carries water and food.

6. B — Digested food passes through its wall into the blood
   Absorption takes place there.

7. B — A wooden toy horse
   A toy is not alive. It does not feed, grow or reproduce.

8. A — It reduces evaporation from the soil
   Covered soil stays moist longer.

9. D — A water treatment plant
   Treatment plants clean used water.

10. B — Growing
   A caterpillar grows and changes form to become a butterfly.

11. C — Sugarcane
   Sugarcane stems store sugar.

12. A — Dung
   Animal dung rots and can be used as manure.

13. B — A stone
   A stone keeps its shape.

14. A — So crops get enough water, light and space
   Weeds compete with crops for water, light and room.

15. C — We breathe air
   Air gives us oxygen for breathing.

SECTION B
----
16. (5 marks)
   Answer: You need a tin or container, soil, a bean seed and water. Plant the seed, water a little each day, measure the shoot with a ruler every two days and record heights in a table. Observe roots and leaves.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for materials, 1 mark for planting, 1 mark for watering, 1 mark for measuring, 1 mark for recording.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: Drying grain and crops, hatching chicks, keeping chicks warm, cooking, controlling pests, drying fish.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: A force changes the shape of dough, starts a ball moving, stops a bicycle with brakes and changes the direction of a ball when hit with a stick.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each effect with an example.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: A vertebrate has a backbone and an invertebrate has no backbone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each part.
